description: Append-only, hash-chained record of an agent behavior change proposal or decision. Advisory review trail, not a sandbox.

hashing.canonicalization: recursive key sort, no whitespace (see ledger.js canon())
hashing.entry_hash: sha256hex(canon(entry minus entry_hash, with prev_hash set))

seal.description: The canonical published ledger.json is Ed25519-sealed at publish time. seal.json carries {tip_hash, count, sealed_at, signature} over canonical bytes of {tip_hash, count, sealed_at}. Public key: keys/ed25519.pub.
